title: Added-Name Charge
content:
**Billing calculation note — SSL/TLS Certificates added-name charge**

Apart from complimentary names, names are added to an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription one name to an order, and the added-name charge of such an order is its per-name part plus the name validation handling fee of 4.00, where the per-name part is the product's price per added name per year multiplied by the calendar days from today to the subscription end date and divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent before the fee is added.

## Quantities

- **Term line.** An added name is billed into the subscription's term line: the purchase, renewal or auto-renew charge line whose period ends on the subscription end date, the latest by charge date where several do. A renewal line that was later refunded no longer carries the term, its refund having brought the subscription end date back to that line's period start. The added name is billed from today to that end date.
- **Yearly price.** The yearly price of an added name is the product's price per added name per year with every multiplier that applies to it.
- **Days.** The calendar days from today to the subscription end date, counted as whole days.
- **Per-name part.** The yearly price multiplied by those days and divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Charge.** The per-name part, with the fees the added name carries then added — the name validation handling fee of 4.00 — and the result rounded half up to the cent.

## Order of the calculation

1. Yearly price of the name.
2. Per-name part over the days to the end date, rounded half up to the cent.
3. The fees added to the rounded per-name part; the total rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Harborline DV Multi-Domain subscription has a price per added name per year of 14.99, and 317 calendar days remain from today to its end date.

- Per-name part: 14.99 multiplied by 317 and divided by 365 is about 13.0187, rounded half up to 13.02.
- Charge: 13.02 plus the handling fee of 4.00 is 17.02.
